name: Percival
source:
"Yeees, I'm a bunny. By the way, where are we...?"

Based on Percival, who is one of King Arthur's legendary Knights of the Round Table. He is most famous for his involvement in the quest for the Holy Grail.

A knight of the Round Table under [url=/c5147]Arthur's[/url] command. She has a light-hearted, worry-free personality. She is extremely bad with directions, and will get lost the instant you let her out of your sight.

Considering she is also highly gullible, her fellow knights constantly worry about her. She wants to become a full-fledged adult one day so that they won't have to worry about her anymore.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char12g]English official site[/url]]
